# Climate scenario (`climate-scenario` v1)

An NGFS climate scenario: carbon price path, warming and sector shocks.

**Group:** Climate · **Mnemonic:** `NGFS` · **Identifiers:** `NGFS-…` in `scenarioId`

Open one with `NGFS <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: climate-scenario
version: 1
description: "An NGFS climate scenario: carbon price path, warming and sector shocks."
match: { kind: climate-scenario, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Climate · Climate scenario, id: $.scenarioId }
strip:
  - { label: Scenario, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Category, bind: $.category }
  - { label: Warming by 2100, bind: $.warming, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Carbon price 2030, bind: $.carbon2030, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Carbon price 2050, bind: $.carbon2050, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: carbon
    kind: line
    title: Carbon price (USD per tCO2e)
    key: F2
    rows: $.carbonPath
    x: year
    y: price
    fmt: amount0
  - id: shocks
    kind: table
    title: "Sector shocks (equity value, 2030)"
    key: F3
    rows: $.shocks
    columns:
      - { label: Sector, bind: "@.sector" }
      - { label: Shock, bind: "@.shock", fmt: pct0, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
